title: Shared definitions
description: Types shared by every v1 message.

id.description: Opaque id (EmDash ULID, review ULID, eventId ULID)

surrogateNo.description: Surrogate integer issued by the plugin (D3): unique per site, starts at 1, never reused; reviewNo is stable across review rounds. Maps to WpPage.wpPostId / WpContentReview.wpPipelineId

eventType.description: Known types are listed in contract.md §6.2. Unknown types MUST be stored as plain events, not rejected.

member.description: An Agency OS user (memberId = OS User.id UUID)

osActor.description: The Agency OS user (or OS automation) on whose behalf an OS -> site call is made

anyOf.description: EmDash role (contributor, author, editor, admin) or OS role when source=os

onBehalfOf.description: v1.1.0: an OWNER acted for the client

plugin.description: v1.6.0: with source plugin, the EmDash plugin id (site-sentinel, oasis-backup)

siteActor.description: Who caused a site-side change. source=os when the change came from a signed OS call (osUserId set).

field.description: body = the entry content (page layout blocks or post body)

anyOf.description: optional, only with field=body: the block _key to narrow the quote

quote.description: plain text the client is commenting on, copied from the content (quote + replacement is the main mode)

proposedText.description: plain text replacement; never HTML; never applied automatically

draftRevisionId.description: applied only: the new draft revision that contains the text

outline.description: v1.0.6: content-map data derived from the rendered block content (Portable Text + block fields)

rev.description: v1.2.1: the exact token to send as draft-upsert baseRev (same value draft-upsert returns as rev)

template.description: Always null on EmDash (WP template/isElementor have no equivalent)

outlineHash.description: v1.0.6: sha256hex of the canonical outline JSON (outline.mjs canonicalOutline)

outlineOmitted.description: v1.0.6: true when inventory left out outline to stay under ~2 MiB (outlineHash kept); fetch it with entry-get

live.description: v1.0.6: the LIVE (published) version's own values, present exactly when hasPendingDraft is true. Top-level title/contentHash/wordCount/excerpt/updatedAt are then the pending DRAFT's. seo, slug and path are shared by live and draft (not repeated here)

siteId.description: v1.0.5: the siteId the review was created under (stamped by the site, never rewritten). The OS ignores a Review whose siteId differs from the project's paired siteId

updateMode.description: true when the review is a pending draft revision of a live entry

seq.description: Per-review monotonic sequence (last event applied to this row)

anyOf.description: v1.1.0: where the client decision of this round was made

suggestionCounts.description: v1.1.0: client suggestions on this review, all rounds

anyOf.description: The entry's current live revision (null while the entry is not live). v1.5.2: refreshed by publish, so the pipeline-publish review carries the new live revision

Non-null ONLY in the response/event that minted the link (links are hashed at rest). Receivers keep their stored URL when this is null. v1.5.6 (§32.3): STAFF ONLY (OWNER/PM). The PM link carries PM review rights; never show or send it to client users (client portal, client e-mails, client API responses).
Same rule as pmPreviewUrl

links.description: v1.0.1: token-free link status on every Review (pipeline-get/list included)

anyOf.description: Reserved: null in v1 until a read path into emdash-seo exists
v1.3.0: who published (admin human, or source os with osUserId)
v1.3.0: OWNER override audit (publish without client_approved)

history.description: Most recent items, oldest first. Sites send at most the last 25; receivers accept up to 100. seq is authoritative; heal gaps with pipeline-get / events-replay.

type.description: EmDash field type: string, text, select, boolean, number, integer, image, repeater, portableText, … (unknown types: the site validates)

defaultValue.description: v1.5.4: the value the site stores when the field is omitted (e.g. page_hero.show_call_button true). The OS editor should start from it, and send false explicitly to turn a default-true boolean off

version.description: v1.0.4: current block schema version; the site stamps it as _version on draft-upsert. The OS may send _version only if it equals this, else 422 SCHEMA_INVALID

blockSchema.description: Fields of one approved block type (from the site's seed/schema)

migrationMap.description: v1.5.0: the site was migrated from WordPress and serves migration-map

layoutRead.description: v1.5.1: entry-get includeLayout returns the editable content (layout / portableText / body.markdown) exactly as draft-upsert accepts it

draftPushFromOs.description: v1.2.0: draft-upsert applies exact slug/parent/bylines/taxonomies through the site-only service token, returns seoCheck, enforces CONTRACT_LOCKED

seoGateOnPush.description: v1.2.0: the site runs the emdash-seo draft checks and locked-contract guard on every OS push

atomicDraftUpdate.description: v1.5.7 (§33.3): draft-upsert updates are one compare-and-set on baseRev (EmDash REST _rev through the service token). false: updates are refused with SERVICE_TOKEN_UNAVAILABLE reason cas, unless the site admin allowed non-atomic updates

draftHash.description: v1.5.7 (§33.4): draft-upsert and entry-get editable return draftHash

security.description: v1.6.0 (§36): security-status, security-history and security.* events (site-sentinel's in-process API is present)

backups.description: v1.6.0 (§36): backup-status and backup.* events (a backup status record exists on the site)

logs.description: v1.6.0 (§36): logs-pull (false until the Phase 3 log ring buffer ships; the route answers 501)

securityConfig.description: v1.6.1 (§37): security-config-get / security-config-set / security-run / security-ack and the security.config_changed / security.acknowledged events (site-sentinel's API has the config methods)

capabilities.description: Feature flags; the OS UI is driven by these, never by version strings

parentOptions.description: v1.2.0: allowed parent section values (select options); empty/absent = no parent field

taxonomies.description: v1.2.0: taxonomy names attached to this collection

allowedSourceHosts.description: hosts the site may fetch from (its static allowedHosts); exact or *.domain, case-insensitive

allowedSourcePathPrefixes.description: v1.2.1: https URL prefixes (origin + path) the site may fetch from, e.g. the OS staging area https://account.localwaves.ai/uploads/cms-staging/

anyOf.description: v1.2.0: emdash-seo draft check of the pushed draft (advisory at push time; the publish gate still decides)

pageId.description: v1.4.0: profile page_id = OS ContentMapNode.pageId (e.g. P12)

anyOf.description: collection:slug

status.description: emdash-seo lifecycle status (planned, drafting, in-review, published, blocked, retired, …)

profile_hash.description: hash of the stored profile; send as expectedProfileHash on profile-upsert

anyOf.description: v1.5.2 (always set on seo.* events): the profile's CMS entry
v1.5.2 (always set on seo.* events): collection:slug
v1.5.2 (always set on seo.* events): public path (trailing slash) when the entry exists, else null

targeting.description: primary_keyword, owner_key, intent, intent_note, secondary_keywords[], avoid_terms[], target_words

contract_body.description: the contract content: title, h1, meta, answer_first_lead, required_blocks[], locked_faq_questions[], required_links_out[], schema_types[], allowed_prices

anyOf.description: latest check run: summary + failed rules (<= 50)
last 4 chars of the old WP bridge key, so the OWNER can recognise the project (never the key)

migratedFrom.description: v1.5.0: this EmDash site replaces a WordPress site the OS knew

fields.description: PII: only in lead events; never in logs, other events or snapshots

photos.description: private media, signed URLs valid 7 days

mediaRef.description: v1.2.0: drop this object into a block image field

until.description: since + 30 days: from then on the normal 72 h give-up applies again, cut-over or not

anyOf.description: v1.5.3 (§29): the outbox give-up clock is paused (events kept and retried at least hourly) while the current pairing of a WordPress-migrated site waits for the OS cut-over; null or absent = not paused
current key generation (null: not paired)
previous generation still accepted (24 h overlap after a normal rotation); null when none
when the previous pair stops being accepted
v1.5.6 (§32.1): when the site last dropped a previous pair immediately because a rotation carried revokePrev: true; null when never

keyState.description: v1.5.6 (§32.1): the site's key state. Never contains a key.

keys.description: v1.5.6 (§32.1): key generation and previous-key state (prevRevokedAt after a revokePrev rotation). Absent from sites below 1.5.6

usable.description: the token authenticates (same input as capabilities.draftPushFromOs)

role.description: the service user's EmDash role as far as the site can tell (editor = Editor or higher when only probed)

anyOf.description: false: some writes answer 403 SERVICE_ROLE_INSUFFICIENT (e.g. Edit in Agency OS on pages made in the site admin); null: not verified yet

serviceTokenState.description: v1.5.4 (§30.1): state of the site-only service token (never the token itself). Show problems to the OWNER/PM: they are fixed by the site admin. v1.5.5 (§31.1): sent in site-info AND in the handshake/heartbeat body; when a body has no serviceToken (sites below 1.5.5) the OS keeps the last known value

previewConfigured.description: v1.0.4: the site has a preview secret (EMDASH_PREVIEW_SECRET or the plugin setting); review links work only when true

contractRevision.description: v1.0.1+: errata level the sender implements (informational; X-AOS-Contract stays 1)

serviceToken.description: v1.5.5 (§31.1, e2e O25): same value as site-info.serviceToken, so a heartbeat refreshes it instead of clearing it. Absent from sites below 1.5.5: keep the last known value

draftHash.description: v1.5.7 (§33.4): "v1:" + sha256 hex of the canonical JSON (RFC 8785 style) of the stored draft. Compare for equality; vectors/draft-hash-v1.json

fields.description: The other stored data fields of the draft ("_"-prefixed keys dropped)

bylines.description: Explicit byline credits (slugs) in credit order

taxonomies.description: Assigned term slugs per taxonomy, sorted; taxonomies without terms left out

draftHashBasis.description: v1.5.7 (§33.4): the draft-hash input without content. canonical draft = { v: 1, ...hashBasis, content: { format, value } }

block.description: One approved block (fields per the site's block schema). Raw HTML blocks are rejected with UNKNOWN_BLOCK.

rev.description: The entry's current rev: send it as draft-upsert baseRev (same value as entry.rev). For variant live with a pending draft, a push on it REPLACES the pending draft

anyOf.description: The revision the content was read from (draftRevisionId / liveRevisionId, or v<version> for a never-published entry). Informational

format.description: Which draft-upsert content key the site uses for this collection (layout = approved blocks, portableText = rich text, markdown = body.markdown where the site stores Markdown)

anyOf.description: The variant's excerpt where the collection has one, as draft-upsert.excerpt

layout.description: Approved blocks exactly as stored (_type, _key, _version, every field value incl. image/media references); send back unchanged fields unchanged

portableText.description: Portable Text exactly as stored (never HTML)

bytes.description: UTF-8 bytes of the JSON of the content value (layout / portableText / markdown string)

limit.description: The limit that was exceeded (bytes or blocks)

omitted.description: Set INSTEAD of the content when a draft-upsert carrying it would exceed the draft-upsert limits (LAYOUT_READ_LIMITS); edit this entry in the EmDash admin

hashBasis.description: v1.5.7 (§33.4), variant draft only: everything draftHash covers except the content value (which is layout / portableText / body here), exactly as hashed

valid.description: false when the stored content no longer passes the site's current block schemas (draft-upsert would answer 422 SCHEMA_INVALID / UNKNOWN_BLOCK until the errors are fixed)

errors.description: Present when valid is false: the same paths draft-upsert would report ($.layout[i]...)

editableContent.description: v1.5.1 (entry-get includeLayout, capability layoutRead): the requested variant's content in exactly the shape draft-upsert accepts. Exactly one of layout / portableText / body, or omitted. Never HTML.

siteId.description: v1.0.4: the siteId current when the site CREATED the event (stamped by the site). Must equal the batch siteId; events-replay returns only events of the requesting siteId

cursor.description: Site-wide monotonic outbox number (one counter per site, never reused). Used for replay (sinceCursor).

seq.description: Per-review monotonic sequence; required on pipeline_* events, absent on content.* (ordered by entry.updatedAt)

snapshotText.description: At most one event per batch may carry it

override.description: true when an admin bypassed the review state machine (audited)

data.description: Type-specific payload for site.* and reserved seo.* events; pipeline_cancelled { force }; v1.5.9 pipeline_reopened { from, reason, by, round, changed, changedTotal? } and pipeline_unscheduled { cause } (§35)

changed.description: v1.4.0 seo.profile_changed: changed fields and who owns them (owner os => OS drift row)

osRequest.description: as content.saved osRequest: the signed OS call behind the change (draft-upsert, profile-upsert, …)

cause.description: v1.5.4 (§30.10) seo.profile_changed / seo.contract_locked: why the profile changed, so the OS tells its own and publish/lifecycle changes from a person's site edit. Absent from sites below 1.5.4

osRequest.description: v1.2.0: set on content.* events caused by a signed OS call (e.g. draft-upsert), so the OS can correlate

suggestions.description: v1.1.0: suggestions created with a client decision (pipeline_client_changes_requested)

from.description: The review status before the save (scheduled: the schedule was removed first, pipeline_unscheduled with data.cause content_changed)

by.description: Who saved the content change (same as the event actor)

round.description: The new round (the client decides it); = review.round

changed.description: Content field paths that changed (§35.2), at most 20

changedTotal.description: How many content paths changed (> changed.length when the list was cut at 20)

data.description: v1.5.9 (§35) pipeline_reopened: the approved review went back to pending_client_review

cause.description: v1.5.9 (§35): content_changed = removed because the content changed after client approval (a pipeline_reopened follows)

hasPendingDraft.description: v1.0.7: a deleted entry has no pending draft

rev.description: v1.2.1: the exact token to send as draft-upsert baseRev (same value draft-upsert returns as rev)

template.description: Always null on EmDash (WP template/isElementor have no equivalent)

outlineHash.description: v1.0.6: sha256hex of the canonical outline JSON (outline.mjs canonicalOutline)

outlineOmitted.description: v1.0.6: true when inventory left out outline to stay under ~2 MiB (outlineHash kept); fetch it with entry-get

live.description: v1.0.6: the LIVE (published) version's own values, present exactly when hasPendingDraft is true. Top-level title/contentHash/wordCount/excerpt/updatedAt are then the pending DRAFT's. seo, slug and path are shared by live and draft (not repeated here)

entryRef.description: Reduced entry for content.deleted (v1.0.1): the last summary the site saw; updatedAt = deletion time

securityIdentity.description: v1.6.0 (§36.5): an opaque site user id and/or a role class; never a name or e-mail. The OS never resolves it to a person

id.description: <category>.<name>, e.g. edge.hsts; ids are never reused for a different meaning

anyOf.description: why the state is unknown (absent / null otherwise)
when the current state began

clientSummary.description: plain-language client wording; present ONLY for checks the site marks client-visible

evidence.description: what was observed, redacted (§36.5), <= 8192 bytes of UTF-8 JSON; omitted in detail=summary

refs.description: threat ids of the security plan (T-19, …)

acknowledged.description: v1.6.1 (§37.5): present while an acknowledgement is active (agency-only: never shown to the client)

anyOf.description: when the next successful archive is due; the OS raises backup.missed itself when it passes (plus grace)
when the next successful archive is due; the OS raises backup.missed itself when it passes (plus grace)
client-entered free text: untrusted, render as text
when the next successful archive is due; the OS raises backup.missed itself when it passes (plus grace)
when the next successful archive is due; the OS raises backup.missed itself when it passes (plus grace)

securityBackups.description: v1.6.0: backup state as the backup plugin reported it. Never a credential, host or path

catalogueVersion.description: version of the check catalogue the site runs: a check missing from checks[] is not run there, never ok

checks.description: detail=summary: non-ok checks only, without evidence

items.description: <category>.<name>, e.g. edge.hsts; ids are never reused for a different meaning

disabled.description: catalogue checks switched off on this site (not scored)

securityStatus.description: v1.6.0 (§36.2): the site's security status model (security plan §4.4)

id.description: <category>.<name>, e.g. edge.hsts; ids are never reused for a different meaning

truncated.description: more than 50 checks changed; pull security-status for the rest

id.description: <category>.<name>, e.g. edge.hsts; ids are never reused for a different meaning

source.description: v1.6.1: what started the scan (os = security-run; the scanId is the one security-run returned)

partial.description: v1.6.1: true when only some checks ran (security-run checkIds); counts still cover every enabled check

summary.description: written by a person on the site, redacted; plain text

anyOf.description: path only; query strings are dropped
opaque site user id or a role class (owner, editor, agent, system)
IP hashed with a daily salt; never the IP
bucketed family, e.g. chrome-desktop

data.description: flat, allow-listed keys per event, redacted, <= 2048 bytes

anyOf.description: plain text written by a person, redacted; agency-only (never shown to the client)

active.description: until is in the future and the check has not changed state since (§37.5)

securityAcknowledgement.description: v1.6.1 (§37.5): a person acknowledged a failing / warning check (snooze). by.name is always null; the OS resolves by.osUserId

id.description: <category>.<name>, e.g. edge.hsts; ids are never reused for a different meaning

anyOf.description: null = the catalogue / site default (defaultSchedule)
plain text written by a person, redacted; agency-only (never shown to the client)

clientVisible.description: false for checks without client wording

schedule.description: allowed schedule values ([] = fixed, e.g. host-worker checks)

snooze.description: can be acknowledged now (enabled and fail / warn)

securityConfigCheck.description: v1.6.1 (§37.2): one catalogue check's settings on this site, with what may be changed

emailOnCritical.description: the site e-mails a failing critical check (fallback when the OS is down)

dedupeHours.description: at most one e-mail per check per this many hours

recipientsMode.description: site = the site setting "Alert e-mails"; os = the site sends none

siteRecipients.description: how many addresses the site setting holds (never the addresses)

rev.description: compare-and-set token: security-config-set baseRev must equal it; +1 per applied write

checks.description: every catalogue check, enabled or not

configured.description: a worker key exists (never the key)

securityConfig.description: v1.6.1 (§37.2): the security check settings of the site (the site is the source of truth)

anyOf.description: <category>.<name>, e.g. edge.hsts; ids are never reused for a different meaning

id.description: a check id, or "alerts" for the alert settings

rev.description: the new config rev; consecutive per site (a gap: pull security-config-get)

truncated.description: more changes than listed; pull security-config-get

osRequest.description: the signed OS call behind the change (absent for site-admin changes)

checkId.description: <category>.<name>, e.g. edge.hsts; ids are never reused for a different meaning

anyOf.description: plain text written by a person, redacted; agency-only (never shown to the client)

osRequest.description: the signed OS call behind the change (absent for site-admin changes)
